title: Hopeful: Evenly
description: Storage Improvements to find a balance between vanilla and modded
body:
This mod aims to expand on vanilla's storage mechanics and make the item management a puzzle-like system in the game.
Currently, this mod has placable bundles, that function the same as shulker boxes.
Additionally, the functionality is there for bundles to only accept specific items, allowing for a more interesting diversity of bundles (not yet implemented).
